text:
Maya: Dropped a new compact canary frame in Figma. Two asks: VoiceOver reading order for status vs percentage, and behavior when chips wrap on narrow screens. https://www.figma.com/file/NEW/compact-canary-legend
Priya: On quick scan VoiceOver reads 'Canary D 15%' before the status pill. Status should be announced first. Recommend semantic reorder so status is earlier in DOM, then visually reorder with CSS. Also overflow must be keyboard operable.
Jordan: Implementation note: we can keep DOM status-first and use CSS `order` to keep visual layout. Avoid aria-only hacks. Add `aria-describedby` on the variant row pointing to the status element id.
Maya: Concern: when chips wrap they push the rollback CTA down which looks noisy. Prefer a compact overflow instead of wrapping.
Sam: Agreed. Let's collapse extras into a '+N' overflow chip that opens a popover. Important: rollback CTA must remain visible without extra vertical push. Also want to A/B test microcopy: Variant A = 'Roll back' (control), Variant B = 'Revert'. Track with analytics label `copy_variant`.
Priya: Accessibility checklist: overflow must be a keyboard-focusable button with `aria-expanded`, visible focus ring, expanded list should be a proper role (listbox/menu), hidden items should set `aria-hidden`, and ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 for critical state pills in all themes.
Luca: I'll add feature flag `compact_canary_legend_v1` and flag `copy_variant` for analytics. I'll prototype the overflow interaction with accessible focus management (no trap, simple popover).
deploy-bot: Staging deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/deploys/compact-legend-v3
Jordan: CSS sketch:
.variant-row { display:flex; align-items:center; }
.status { order: 1; }
.legend { order: 2; }
.overflow-chip { white-space:nowrap; }
Maya: Great. I'll update Figma with a narrow-width frame and the DOM notes, then tag Priya for another pass.
Priya: Will review once figma has DOM annotations. Quick dev checklist for this thread: 1) status element early in DOM; 2) visual parity via CSS ordering; 3) accessible overflow chip button + aria-expanded; 4) collapsed items aria-hidden; 5) contrast tokens >=4.5:1; 6) analytics includes copy_variant.
Sam: Plan: Jordan implements DOM/CSS this sprint, Luca wires analytics/feature flag, QA validates on staging next week, then we run the A/B test in canary.
Maya: Thanks all. Leaving figma + staging links in thread for follow-up. :thumbsup:
